dataset_citation: Homer Walke et al., BridgeData V2: A Dataset for Robot Learning at Scale, CoRL 2023.

source.instruction: fold the cloth from the right to the left side

image_preparation: Recorded frame reconstructed from the public TFRecord. The plotted image is converted to grayscale and overlaid with token Grad-CAM.
scope: single fixed BridgeV2 source, model-specific visual contribution
target_normalization: Displayed positive Grad-CAM divided by the maximum across the four layers of each model.
